identity.title: Separate inspection NG from execution failures in the 2D Result

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: The 2D plan identified that the local 2D consumer always translated a failed Runner result into Completed/Ng. The bounded change uses the existing typed step status and error fields to preserve quality NG while publishing execution failures and cancellation with the existing v2 Result contract.

state.current_summary: TwoDIntegrationExchange now classifies typed step outcomes before writing a run record: only acceptance NG publishes Completed/Ng; execution failures publish Failed/ExecutionError without run identity; cancellation publishes Cancelled/Indeterminate. Final Debug/Release contracts, app builds, and matching clean/dirty integration smokes pass.

claims.text: RunAcceptedHandoffAsync previously selected Completed and then used VisionRecipeRunResult.Success to choose Pass or Ng, so a ToolFactoryFailed, InvalidRoi, StepTimeout, or cancellation represented by a failed step could be exposed as Completed/Ng instead of an execution or cancellation result.

problem.impact: Downstream consumers could treat an execution failure as a normal inspected part and choose the wrong retry, alarm, or reject path.

criteria.text: The existing TwoDIntegrationExchange owner classifies Result status/outcome from typed step status and fields: quality NG is Completed/Ng; execution failure is Failed/ExecutionError; cancellation is Cancelled/Indeterminate.
ToolFactoryFailed, InvalidRoi, StepTimeout, unknown/incomplete states, and StepCanceled are covered by focused contract cases without guessing from exception-message text.
The existing Result correlation, run-record, metric, and consumer parser path remains intact for the existing 2D integration smoke; a dirty runtime remains fail-closed before acknowledgement/run.
OpenVisionLab and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke build cleanly in Debug and Release with no warnings or errors.
The existing v2 contract package, recipe XML format, TCP/ACK/Run separation, and Dev/Original boundary remain unchanged.

context.location: TwoDIntegrationExchange writes the immutable v2 Result; VisionRecipeRunResult.Steps owns typed step status/tool/error/acceptance state; RunLease owns transaction execution lifetime.

artifacts.summary: Focused result-disposition contracts, Debug/Release runner and app builds, and dirty-runtime integration fail-closed smoke logs.

evidence.observation: The Result construction now calls ClassifyRunResult. The classifier uses VisionRecipeStepRunSummary.Status, ToolSuccess, AcceptancePassed, ErrorCode, and ErrorName: only typed NG is Completed/Ng; CANCEL is Cancelled/Indeterminate; other failed or incomplete states are Failed/ExecutionError with ExecutionFailed.

The focused 2D integration result-disposition contract passed 8/0 in Debug and 8/0 in Release, covering Pass, acceptance NG, ToolFactoryFailed, InvalidRoi, StepTimeout, StepCanceled, all-skipped, and unknown status cases.
The existing integration smoke preserved ThreeD/HeightMap rejection, missing-manifest and identity/hash fail-closed checks, and dirty-runtime refusal before Result publication with exit 0.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionLab Debug/Release builds completed with exit code 0, warnings 0, and errors 0.

The final call path classifies the VisionRecipeRunResult before creating a Run Record. Completed/Pass and Completed/Ng keep the existing run identity and record; Failed/ExecutionError and Cancelled/Indeterminate call PublishFailedResult with no run identity or Run Record, matching the v2 validator contract. Step detail remains typed Status/ErrorCode/ErrorName.

The final focused 2D integration result-disposition contract passed 9/0 in Debug and 9/0 in Release, including v2 validation of Failed/ExecutionError without run identity plus Pass, acceptance NG, ToolFactoryFailed, InvalidRoi, StepTimeout, StepCanceled, all-skipped, and unknown status cases.
The final VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionLab Debug/Release builds completed with exit code 0, warnings 0, and errors 0.

The matching-assembly dirty-runtime integration smoke passed after the final change: ThreeD/HeightMap rejection, missing-manifest, identity/hash tamper checks, and dirty-runtime refusal before acknowledgement/Result publication all passed with exit 0.

A matching-assembly synthetic-clean Debug integration smoke passed after the final change: Good=Pass and Bad=Ng retained their Run IDs, run-record/metric correlation, concurrent-run lease guard, explicit rejection/tamper checks, and runtime identity fail-closed checks.

events.summary: The typed external-result disposition owner, focused failure/cancellation cases, dirty-runtime integration regression, and Debug/Release build gates are complete.
